decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in console-split-chunks.txt: entry chunk returns 200 but sibling hashed imports 404 because they were never shipped, failing the whole dynamic import; fix is a single self-contained bundle with code splitting disabled.

Uses chunk-route.ts and ci-note.md precisely: LIB_DIR keeps uppercase E:\ while realpathSync returns lowercase e:\, so case-sensitive startsWith rejects a contained file; Linux passes because casing is consistent, and it correctly rejects the 'Windows is unreliable' folklore.
Proposes path.relative with non-empty/non-'..'/non-absolute acceptance on canonical paths, keeps realpath as defense-in-depth against symlink escapes, and retains the JavaScript MIME requirement.

Explains both pane capture-phase Ctrl+wheel font handler and modal zoom handler act on one gesture; gives modal exclusive ownership with preventDefault/stopPropagation plus pane standing down, noting stopPropagation cannot undo an earlier ancestor capture listener.

Covers all three incidents: fallback-to-code-block on chunk failure, case-differing contained path served while traversal is refused, single-file artifact assertion, and modal Ctrl+wheel zooms diagram without altering pane font.

caps.reason: The report strengthens containment with path.relative plus realpath defense-in-depth; it never proposes disabling the guard or serving paths outside the plugin root.
